items.reason: This describes unescaped Referer interpolation into JavaScript in the embed layout, a separate injection point from the golden issues.
Both describe stored XSS caused by interpolating an unescaped URL into the imported post's HTML footer.
Both describe missing feed content causing i.content.scrub to raise and abort processing of remaining items.
This describes missing fetch timeouts and response-size limits. Issue #19 concerns unhandled fetch failures and nil content, which require different fixes.
This describes a crash between separate Redis setnx and expire commands leaving a permanent throttle key; no golden issue covers this atomicity problem.
Both describe concurrent imports racing through check-then-create and aborting the losing job with an unhandled RecordNotUnique.
Both describe distinct article requests bypassing the per-URL throttle and repeatedly triggering synchronous full-feed downloads and imports.
